key_insight: Layer-wise generalizations of Barron norms characterize expected optimal discretization of infinite-width layers into finite deep networks.
engineering_relevance: The theory could guide layer-wise allocation of finite network capacity to control approximation error.
method: Separate approximation into selecting infinite-width layer limits and discretizing them.
Characterize expected discretization error using layer-wise Barron norms.
Analyze local minima through an equidistribution principle analogous to adaptive spline and finite element approximation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical characterizations and optimization-landscape analysis, but no datasets or numerical benchmarks.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish a practical algorithm for finding optimal infinite-width layers or their finite discretizations.
paper_title: Barron Smoothness for Layers in Deep Neural Networks
